formula: Delta Euler omega = integral(a4 phi + a2(v) delta + a1(v) actual_delta_dot)dt + unmodeled residual
integration: trapezoid over actual saved timestamps; no smoothing or fitted coefficients
residual: model discrepancy including contact, variable-speed/coupling/nonlinear effects and sampling; NOT identified pure terrain impulse
windows: first front/rear raised contact+100ms; fixed1.5/1.8/1.9/2.1/2.3+100ms; last100ms. Truncated windows retained and flagged.
